en:
I recognize that this meeting has not
come at the best of times for either of us.

However, I believe we can still
salvage a beneficial relationship.

Once you have calmed down a bit,
I would like to meet with you again.

Tomorrow night.
It will be only the two of us.

I would be glad to give answers
to several of your questions there.
That's a good deal for me.
But tell me, what do you get out of it?

First off, I don't have to sully the fine
wood floors of this place with your blood.
There is more to it than that, though.

At the moment, we are at war with the Tojo Clan.
The Yomei Alliance is also involved, as you know.

You have the ability to speak to the leaders
of both organizations equally, Kiryu-san.

There is great value in
my showing you hospitality.
Do you accept my invitation?

Yeah, I get it.
Tomorrow, then.

Meet him in the ruins of a
brothel called Shangri-La.

Remember... The boss
only invited you, Kiryu-san.

What's the latest on the Tojo Clan's
little war in Kamurocho?
How long is it going to drag on?
It's already nearly over.

I know it's caused a great deal of tension
in Kanto. You have my sympathies.
It's nice to be wined-and-dined like this...

...But if the triads keep fucking with us,
we're gonna get laughed at in Kansai.

Kamurocho is the heart of Kanto's yakuza.
We need it to be stable.

He's right. All we're really asking here
is that you rising stars do your part.

And we will, Senpai. I'm grateful to even
have a seat at the same table as you.

I've also heard rumblings that the
Dragon of Dojima is back in Kamurocho?
Indeed. Word travels fast.

You can't let a civilian keep walking
around like he owns the place.

This is the dawn of your time at
the head of the clan, Someya-san.

Tell that washed-up old fuck to
crawl back into his hole.
Old fuck?

You heard me. Maybe he was great
once, but those days are long gone.

It's the present that makes the man,
not the past.

There's no place for a puffed-up
has-been like him anymore.
Hey, give it a rest.
The hell!?

So you're trying to tell me
we both want the same thing here?
Indeed. Am I wrong?
You're even more naive than I thought.

If what you just said is true, you're the
reason Daigo is behind bars right now.

You know, he was only a child
when we first met.

And after he left the yakuza, it was me who
dragged him back to become the sixth chairman.

In other words, you have no interest
in forming an alliance with me.

I may have left the clan years ago,
but I'm still yakuza.

Anyone who'd dare to harm someone
I care about... is going to pay the price.
That shouldn't come as a surprise.

Your ability to succeed with such
minimal planning... It's impressive.

By defeating me in front of Lo-san, you could
potentially earn the trust of the Saio Triad.

It wouldn't be the first time your integrity
has charmed men who were once your foes.

It's that charisma that helped you
ascend the ranks all those years ago.

I only seek the same for myself,
though my methods are more calculated.
What are you trying to say?
Fourth Chairman...

You and I aren't so different.
Just different means to the same end.
Don't flatter yourself.
This should be a fascinating sight.

So the fourth chairman is going to
grace me with the honor of a duel.
I won't be needing this, then.
This time, I won't hold anything back.
Neither will I.

You're truly...
the Dragon of Dojima.
Looks like I'm finished.

No matter how hard I struggle,
I'll never be able to escape you.
So! Who gets to finish me off?
Will it be you?
Or perhaps you, Lo-san?

Apologies, but I cannot offer you
any knowledge of Tatsukawa's betrayal.

Though it might be different if you joined
the Saio Triad by swearing allegiance to me.

But in truth, you have no need to learn
the details of Tatsukawa's death.
The reason for that being...
...He is not Haruto Sawamura's father.

Someone else is the father.
I assure you.

I don't understand.
How could you possibly know that?
Do you have information on Haruka, too!?

All I can say now is, that child bears great
significance to this war in Kamurocho.

...It seems others are slowly becoming
aware of his true value.

What value are you talking about?
Who the hell is this kid's father!?
You may want to answer that.

The child's situation is becoming
more pressing than you realize.

Oh, Kiryu-aniki! It's Yuta!
Somethin' happened in Hiroshima!
What is it?

I jus' got a call from Kiyomi-san.
It has to do with the boss.
Apparently he disappeared with Haruto.

Why would Hirose take Haruto!?
What's going on here!?
I have no idea!

Hello? Aniki?
Are you still there?
Hello!? Aniki!?
Yuta. Pack for Hiroshima.
We're leaving now!
Someya-san?
Wh-What happened to you!?

That bastard won't be leeching
off you anymore.
I took care of things.

You'll never have to see him again.
He won't be coming back to Tokyo.
Your debt's been cleared, too.
You're free.
Be more careful, huh?
At your age, you should know better.
You did that for me...?
But why?

I don't even have the right to call
myself her mother at this point.
What're y'talkin' about?
That's a load o' bull.
How can y'really be that stupid, huh!?
Y'think this is about the <font_kind=yakuza_italic>right</font_kind>!?

Y'gave her life! She's still yer daughter.
Quit pretendin' that don't mean anythin'!

Y'did the only thing y'could to get away
from that bastard husband o' yers!

Fer real, though. If y'wanna get her back
from Someya, I'll do whatever it takes t'help.

Yer daughter's gonna love ya
no matter what happened before.

That's why y'don't get to quit bein'
her parent. I ain't gonna let ya!

But stuff like that's better comin'
from an ol' buddy like me.
Y'gotta find a way to make things right.
Thank you, Nagumo-kun.
I needed to hear that.

I've been hoping someone would say that
to me ever since I came back to this town.

D'ya ever stop t'think about whose
backyard yer trespassin' in?

It's time I give ya a taste
o' what Hiroshima's really about.

It's an honor to square off
'gainst the Dragon o' Dojima.
I don't fight 'less it's gonna be good.
K-Kiryu!
This ain't over yet!
I think you're about to see otherwise.

What the heck, Aniki!? Why'd ya go n' say that?
Koshimizu totally saw my face!
Too late now.
How'd you guys know to come here?

The lady over at Snack Hourglass
told us. Boss loves that place.

Anyway, we should try to
wake Koshimizu up.
I have some questions for him.
That won't be necessary.
Let Koshimizu have his little nap.
He can't tell ya much anyway.

Kiryu-san. I have answers
to all of yer questions.
Patriarch Hirose...
If what you're saying is true...

...You must know who Haruto's
father actually is, right?

He's a guy y'know pretty
well, Kiryu-san.
Everyone here knows him, too.
So here's yer answer...
You?
Yuta Usami.
It's been under yer noses all along.
You are Haruto Sawamura's father.
Stop it!
Wh-What are you doing, Yuta-kun?
Wait, this is the customer from last night.
Why would you do something like this!?
He's one of those tabloid snakes.

This guy has been tracking you
fer a while, Haruka-chan.

You don't want people taking
pictures of you, right?

Even if folks won't come out n' say it,
we all know who you are.

And we know the last thing you want
is to get spotted by the media.
You knew we were onto ya, didn't you?

Captain Nagumo ain't exactly
an award-winning actor.

But this won't change anything.
We'll keep acting like we don't know.

Everyone in this town loves you
for who you are, Haruka-chan.

It might be awkward for me to
show up 'round Kiyomi-san's now.
But still...

I hope I'll see you around town
still, Haruka-chan. Yeah?

It's been under yer noses all along.
You are Haruto Sawamura's father.
F-For real?
Yuta! Why didn't y'say anythin'!?
We need answers! C'mon!
Forgive me!
So you and Haruka...

Y'couldn'ta mentioned this sooner,
ya slippery fuck!?

Ya know it don't exactly happen by accident!
So c'mon...
Out with it!

Everyone was saying Tatsukawa was
the father. I didn't think it could be me...
Hey, hold on a sec, Yuta.
When y'were with Haruka-chan, uh...
Y'didn't think to bag it up?
C'mon, Yuta.

It ain't true, right?
Jus' tell me it's a lie n' it'll all go away.
Th-Things just kinda happened...
I mean, we only did it once!
How did one time...
Y'fuckin' jackass!
This is neither the time or place.
Patriarch. This isn't making sense.

If Yuta himself didn't know he was
Haruto's dad, how can you be so sure?
Th-That's a good point!
It's sorta hard to explain.
Wouldn't you say?
Wh-What the hell!?
Masuzoe!
Hirose-san. You better keep your promise.

If I do this for you, neither the Saio
nor the Yomei will take me back.

If you abandon me now,
I'll have nowhere left to run.
Just spill the beans already.

You can escape to wherever you want.
Chairman Kurusu will make sure of it.
I-I don't think I'm followin'...
What the hell's goin' on?
You're well aware of what happened next.

The Saio Triad killed Tatsukawa after they
caught him trying to sell the baby to Iwami.
Did you see what they did to him!?

They didn't even spare his girl.
Ed made Tatsukawa watch as he butchered her.

He actually laughed about it
when he told me the story.

Ed took his sweet time with the girl,
then slit Tatsukawa's throat as a mercy.

I know I've sworn lifelong allegiance
to the Saio Triad, but I...

Who knows when I might end up in
the same boat as Tatsukawa now!?

What're y'cryin' about?
You deserve as much, y'shithead.
That's everything I know, Hirose-san!

You promised... Chairman Kurusu will
make sure they can't get to me, right?
Hang onta the kid real tight now.
They're comin' fer Haruto!
Shit! Who the hell're these guys!?
All of you stand back!
Keep Hirose-san and Haruto safe!
G-Got it!
A-Aniki!
Shit, what do I do!?
Cap, toss Haruto t'me!
Sorry 'bout this, kid!

You all get into the town!
Protect Haruto!

[He's getting away!
Catch him!]
Pass 'im!
[Stand down.]
[This one's mine.]
It's you.
Joon-gi Han!
Then get out of my way!
I said move!
Get off yer ass, Yuta.

Y'hear me?
This ain't the time to kick yerself!
Have it yer way!
A-Aniki...?
Only one of us deserves to hit him now.
And that's me, Nagumo.

Care to guess what I'm
upset about right now?

It's not what you did with Haruka,
or the fact that you hid it from us.
Well then? What is it?

Before today,
if a baby had been kidnapped...

...You would've risked your life to
save him without a second thought.
Nagumo and the others, too.
But it's different now.

Why can't you bring yourself
to help him anymore?

Is it because you found out
you have a triad's blood?

Or is it because you know Haruto
shares that same bloodline?
In the end, it doesn't matter.
So don't let something so shallow...
...Make you act like less of a father!

Blood shouldn't change
how you live your life.

And it damn well shouldn't
change how you judge others.

If you can't see past that,
then you're no better than Lo.
As for me...

Even if it kills me,
I'm bringing Haruto back.

You can stay here
sulking for all I care.
If that's your choice...
Don't ever let me see you again.
I'm outta here, too.
Aniki said all I wanted t'say.

All right! We can push off
whenever y'want, Nagumo!
Hold on a sec.
Please take me with you!
I'm begging you!
I wanna help save him!

When they took him away,
I lost all hope.
It seemed like we'd never get him back.
That's why I was such a coward!
Y'know I...

I can't tell you how many times
I've changed Haruto's diaper.

How many times he got shit
n' piss all over me.
But every time...
...He'd give me the brightest little smile.

I don't know what I'd do
if I couldn't see that smile again!
Haruto's...
Haruto is...
...My son!
So please!
You have to let me come with you!

Of course y'can! Get yer ass on
the boat and let's go, buttwipe!
That cool, Aniki?
Don't be ridiculous.
How could I say no to him?

[The girl escaped?
What the hell is Tatsukawa doing!?]
Sorry for the wait, Haruto.
K-Kiryu-san!
It seems... I was right.

I always knew it would be worth
putting my pride on the line to fight you.

If you choose to kill me now,
I'd have no complaints.

The kid doesn't need to see
what I'd do to you, actually.
How can you continue to be so naive?

None of your enemies care about that child.
Not Tsuneo Iwami, and not Lo.

They will come at you with everything
they have to get their hands on him.

Though knowing you, you'll just keep
fighting them to find your answers.

Who knows, you may even uncover
the secret of Onomichi.
The secret of Onomichi again?
